svg.title: JAX Software Stack / Layered Architecture · Compilation, Execution, and Return Paths
svg.desc: JAX and jaxlib are centered; IFRT/PJRT, XLA/compiler backends, and ASM/device runtime sit side by side, with hardware below. Each module highlights one core concept, with separate CPU, GPU, and TPU TensorCore modules and a distinct SparseCore branch. Compilation results return through each layer; execution inputs, output objects, and Pallas inner/outer programs have explicit interfaces.
